title: Acceptance probability within a time bound
statement: For a finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over the Boolean alphabet, a Boolean input $x$, and a time bound $t$, the acceptance probability within the time bound is a rational number assigned to $(N,x,t)$.
caveat: The supplied formal statement leaves the defining expression after the equals sign blank, so it specifies the function's inputs and output type but not how its value is computed.
